name: codex-mcp
description: Lets Codex on this PC talk to the agent in SolidWorks: send it a message and get its reply, and read the open model. Changes it asks for still need your OK in the SolidWorks Agent panel. Adds an MCP server named "solidworks-agent" to Codex's config.toml, which the Codex app, CLI and IDE extension share. Works on this PC only; no agent-bridge needed.

allowModelRead.title: Let Codex read the open model
allowModelRead.description: The solidworks_* tools (model summary, feature tree, selection, open documents), and the open document and chat names in solidworks_status.
